summary:
Iter 43 — 28/28 backend pytests PASS covering: (A) Push reconcile — config?endpoint= returns registered=false then true after /members/push/subscribe (payload {ok, kind:'Android / Chrome'}); _push_device_kind maps fcm.googleapis.com -> 'Android / Chrome', web.push.apple.com -> 'iPhone / iPad', *.notify.windows.com -> 'Windows / Edge'; /members/push/test-self 400 when no devices and 200 {sent,devices} with devices; push_log kind=test row written; re-subscribing same endpoint under mem_tok_b rebinds user_id. (B) Statements — POST /donor/statement-link seeds donor_statement_tokens row and returns generic message; GET /donor/statements/{token} -> years [{year:2025,total:120,count:1}]; .../2025.pdf is application/pdf starting %PDF; year without gifts -> 404; bad token -> 410; rate limit 3/5min returns 429 on 4th. (C) Ticketing — POST /admin/events creates event, PUT /admin/events/{eid}/tickets assigns ids for General+Table-of-8; validation 400 for price 0 / qty 0 / admits 21; GET /events includes ticket_types with remaining; POST /events/{eid}/tickets/checkout returns stripe.com url and pending order; buying more than remaining -> 400; pending reduces remaining; simulated fulfilment (set paid + create tickets qty*admits) + GET /tickets/order/{token} returns tickets; /tickets/qr/{code}.png content-type image/png PNG magic; checkin -> ok:true then already:true; wrong eid -> 404; undo clears checked_in_at; /tickets/report orders=1 revenue=75 seats=1; tickets.csv is text/csv with buyer name; lower qty below sold -> 400; remove type with sales -> 400.
Frontend: Home /, viewport 1920 - home-thermometer renders home-thermo-raised ('$350 of $50,000'), home-thermo-pct ('1%'), home-thermo-donate -> /donate; share-campaign-btn click opens share-campaign-menu with share-copy-link + share-facebook + share-x + share-whatsapp + share-email (hrefs contain URL-encoded %2Fdonate — correct). Mobile 390px no horizontal overflow. Donate page - statement-request form submits and renders statement-msg; DonorWall share-campaign-btn renders in-view. /giving-statement?t=<valid> shows statement-year-2025 + statement-download-2025 (href ends /2025.pdf); bad token shows statement-error. Public /events - event-buy-tickets-btn labelled 'Buy tickets · from $75', opens ticket-picker; ticket-plus-* adds 2 tickets; name/email filled; ticket-pay-btn shows 'Pay $150'. /tickets/{token} shows ticket-1 and ticket-2 QR cards. Admin /admin -> Events tab -> admin-event-tickets-btn opens ticket-types-panel with tt-add, tt-name-0, tt-price-0, tt-qty-0, tt-admits-0, ticket-types-save and ticket-door-link all visible. /admin/tickets/{eid} shows ticket-door-summary '0 of 2 guests checked in · 1 orders · $150 in ticket sales', ticket-door-scan + ticket-door-csv visible, 2 ticket-guest-* rows, 2 ticket-checkin-* buttons, clicking checkin flips to ticket-undo-*. Member portal /members -> portal-tab-me shows push-settings with push-status (push-devices panel conditionally hidden when no server-side subs — correct).
critical_code_review_comments: _push_device_kind host parse via endpoint.split('/')[2] handles missing / safely; 'apple.com' substring match is correct (web.push.apple.com).

members_push_config does 'registered = any(sub.endpoint == endpoint for sub in subs) if endpoint else False' — correct; when endpoint='' the status pill falls back to Off/Unsupported which is the intended UX.

members_push_subscribe uses update_one(upsert=True) on endpoint only — this is the fix for the reported RCA (phones showed 'On' locally but no server row). Also rebinds user_id to current user on re-subscribe, which fixes the 'split across two accounts' bug.

members_push_test_self raises 400 when no devices BUT does NOT verify that _push_users on fake endpoints writes a push_log row — verified: push_log row is created unconditionally by _push_users before delivery attempts.
_fulfil_ticket_order uses find_one_and_update with status:'pending' filter which guarantees idempotency across webhook + /tickets/session poll races. Good.
_tickets_sold counts both paid and pending (within TICKET_HOLD_MIN) orders — ensures double-selling is prevented. 30-min hold is reasonable for Stripe Checkout TTL.
admin_event_tickets rejects remove-with-sales and qty-below-sold by comparing sold map against new types — correct.
event_tickets_checkout cap of 20 per item combined with t.remaining<=20 is enforced; min $1 price prevents $0 'free paid' confusion.
ticket_qr returns image/png with 24h cache header — good for email embedding.
admin_ticket_checkin strips 'CSCT:' prefix cleanly — matches the QR payload format emitted by MyTickets QRCodeSVG and the Scanner reused from CheckIn.

donor_statement_link ALWAYS returns the same generic message (does not leak whether the email has gifts) — the HAS_GIFTS branch only differs by firing a background email with a 24h token. Good privacy.
_statement_token raises 410 on expired/missing — matches spec exactly.
_statement_pdf runs via asyncio.to_thread so reportlab doesn't block the event loop. Good.

DonorWall + HomeThermometer both poll /donations/public every 30s via useCampaign hook — DRY. Minor: two independent 30s intervals; a shared context could save a request on pages mounting both (non-blocking).
ShareCampaign gracefully falls back to a menu when navigator.share is undefined (headless Chromium) — verified working.
PushSettings.syncPush fires silently on portal load inside Members.jsx and inside this component via refresh(). Idempotent re-POST to /subscribe when server missing is a clean reconciler.
server.py still at ~11.3k lines — splitting (push / tickets / statements / events) remains overdue (not blocking).
test_credentials: QA admin cookie session_token=qa_tok_123 and member cookies mem_tok_a / mem_tok_b were brought up for the run and torn down (qa_members.py down + qa_session.py down).
seed_data_creation: Transient rows (all cleaned at end — 0 QA rows remain): events QA Iter43 Gala + QA FE43 Gala; ticket_orders + tickets for those; payment_transactions session_id qa_stmt_1 and qa_fe_stmt_1; donor_statement_tokens for qa-donor/qa-fedonor@example.com; push_subs fake endpoints (fcm/apple/windows) for qa_mem_a/b; push_log kind=test; rate_hits bucket statement-link.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate-limit bucket 'statement-link' is per-IP 3/5min; clear db.rate_hits key regex ^statement-link: before re-running the statement tests. Push test-self with fake endpoints still writes a push_log row even when webpush delivery fails (sent=0, failed=N); don't filter by user_id in push_log — the schema stores membership counts, not uids. Admin tabs are text buttons (not data-testid) — use get_by_role('button', name='Events', exact=True) to switch to Events sub-tab, then admin-event-tickets-btn is visible. DonorWall uses Reveal (IntersectionObserver) so scroll to bottom before asserting share-campaign-btn there.
